posts.heading: September 14, 2026
posts.text:
The day closes with 232 feeder visits and 16 species. The final hours saw a distinct shift in the auditory landscape. Northern Cardinals and Carolina Wrens reasserted their presence in the 19:00 hour.

As dusk approached, the visual log ended with a Ruby-throated Hummingbird at sunset, marking the station's last confirmed visitor. This hummingbird was one of only two seen today, alongside a pair of Gray Catbirds whose presence remained probable. The steady weather, with highs near 30 C and light winds, offered a constant backdrop.

In the final minute before dark, a Northern Mockingbird and a Black-crowned Night Heron added their calls to the fading light.
